ns2:course.label: IT for Networked Organizations
ns2:course.description: Examines the information technology and its impact on modern organizations. Topics include: (1) IT, Internet Technologies, E-Commerce and business models, (2) organizing and modeling enterprise data, (3) Network protocol and architecture, (4) development of IT systems, and (5) IT management and organization design.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Business Undeclared or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Strategy, Innovation & Entrep or Business + Data Science major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
